<style>
.interest-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

/* Hard hide any stray p tags or empty elements Quarto tries to inject */
.interest-grid > p,
.interest-grid > :empty {
  display: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  height: 0 !important;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .interest-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.interest-row {
  display: flex !important;

  background-color: var(--bg-secondary, #f4f6f8);

  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.interest-row:hover {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-color: var(--emerald-quant, #0d9488);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(13, 148, 136, 0.08);
}

.interest-left {
  display: flex;

}

}

.interest-right {

}

}

.interest-row:hover .chevron-icon {
  background-color: var(--emerald-quant, #0d9488);
  border-color: var(--emerald-quant, #0d9488);
  color: #ffffff;
}
</style>
